{"id": "1107bdd8-8077-4aa4-b7cd-b22457abdf99", "role": "assistant", "content": [{"text": "I don't have the ability to analyze pcap/pcapng files directly — that's outside what I can do in this chat. I can't parse packet captures, inspect TCP handshakes, or read TLS negotiation details from a file like that.

Here's what I can actually help with for this issue:

- Look into AWS-side signals around 10.0.2.20:443 — security group rules, network ACLs, target health checks, CloudWatch metrics (connection counts, latency) for whatever resource that IP belongs to (EC2/ELB/etc.)
- Check CloudTrail for recent changes to networking config (security groups, route tables, NACLs) around when the hangs started
- Open a tracked investigation if you want a thorough root-cause dig correlating metrics, logs, and recent changes

Would any of these help, or do you have a packet-level finding from the pcap already (e.g., SYN with no SYN-ACK, TLS ClientHello with no response) that you want me to correlate against AWS-side data?", "type": "text"}], "created_at": null}
